title: 重武器横批
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、右、左。借助重锤、斧或镐的重量，以横向重击扫过目标。
second_page: 重武器横批对刺击、打击和斩击伤害均有强化。命中头部时攻击面部，命中其他部位时则集中伤害腹部。翻到这里，你已经开始练习重武器横批。

en_us.title: Heavy wepaon Mittelhaw
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Right, Left. Use the weight of a hammer, axe, or pickaxe to sweep through the target with a heavy horizontal blow.
en_us.second_page: The heavy version strengthens thrust, strike, and slash damage alike. Head hits target the face; all other hits are focused on the abdomen.
